results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if voice identifier is unknown)]: Discover available voices using ELEVENLABS_GET_VOICES or HEYGEN_LIST_TTS_VOICES (pick a voice matching the desired style/language).
[Optional (if using ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH and model choice must be confirmed)] [Prerequisite]: List supported models using ELEVENLABS_GET_MODELS (select a text-to-speech capable model).

[Optional (if using HEYGEN_GENERATE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH and you want to validate the voice first)] [Next Step]: Generate a short sample using HEYGEN_GENERATE_VOICE_AUDIO_PREVIEW (confirm pronunciation/tone before full output).
[Required] [Step]: Synthesize a downloadable speech audio file using ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH or HEYGEN_GENERATE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH (provide the script text and chosen voice identifier).

[Optional (if incremental audio delivery is required or single-file responses are problematic)] [Fallback]: Generate streaming audio using ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM (handle chunked output client-side).
known_pitfalls: [ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH] Fails if the voice identifier is missing or invalid; run ELEVENLABS_GET_VOICES when unsure.
[HEYGEN_GENERATE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH] Output quality/availability depends on the selected voice; unsupported voices may error or sound unexpected.
[ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM] Returns audio in chunks and requires client-side assembly; not equivalent to a single downloadable file.
[ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH] Execution can be blocked when no active connection is configured.
[HEYGEN_GENERATE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH] Execution can be blocked when no active connection is configured.

ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH.description: Converts text to speech using a specified ElevenLabs voice and model, returning a downloadable audio file (use ELEVENLABS_TEXT_TO_SPEECH_STREAM for streaming instead). Keep `voice_id`, `model_id`, and `output_format` consistent across all chunks to avoid audible artifacts when concatenating. Some voice/model/format combinations require specific subscription tiers; test with a short sample before full runs. HTTP 429 on burst batches; respect `Retry-After` headers.

seed.description: Integer seed for potentially deterministic audio generation. Repeatability with the same seed and parameters is aimed for but not guaranteed.

examples: This is a test of the text-to-speech API.
text.description: Input text for speech conversion. Max 10,000 characters for most models. Flash/Turbo v2 models: up to 30,000. Flash/Turbo v2.5 models: up to 40,000. For long-form content, use Studio.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model for synthesis. List available models via `/v1/models`; ensure chosen model's `can_do_text_to_speech` is true.

voice_id.description: Identifier of the voice for speech generation. Obtainable from the `/v1/voices` endpoint.

output_format.description:
Output audio format. Supported formats include:
- `mp3_22050_32`: 22.05kHz, 32kbps MP3.
- `mp3_44100_32`: 44.1kHz, 32kbps MP3.
- `mp3_44100_64`: 44.1kHz, 64kbps MP3.
- `mp3_44100_96`: 44.1kHz, 96kbps MP3.
- `mp3_44100_128`: 44.1kHz, 128kbps MP3.
- `mp3_44100_192`: 44.1kHz, 192kbps MP3 (Creator tier+).
- `pcm_16000`: 16kHz PCM (S16LE).
- `pcm_22050`: 22.05kHz PCM (S16LE).
- `pcm_24000`: 24kHz PCM (S16LE).
- `pcm_44100`: 44.1kHz PCM (S16LE) (Pro tier+).
- `ulaw_8000`: 8kHz μ-law (for Twilio audio inputs).

style.description: Determines style exaggeration. Recommended to keep at 0. Consumes additional computational resources. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

stability.description: Controls voice consistency. Lower values (0.30-0.50) introduce broader emotional range, higher values (0.60-0.85) create more consistent output. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

similarity_boost.description: Boosts similarity to the original speaker. Higher values risk reproducing background noise if source audio quality is poor. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.

use_speaker_boost.description: Enables speaker boost enhancement. Not available for the Eleven v3 model.

voice_settings.description: Voice settings for controlling speech generation characteristics.

optimize_streaming_latency.description:
Controls latency optimizations for streaming. Higher values reduce latency, potentially affecting quality.
0: No optimizations.
1: Normal (approx. 50% of max improvement vs option 3).
2: Strong (approx. 75% of max improvement vs option 3).
3: Maximum.
4: Maximum with text normalizer disabled (affects number/date pronunciation, best latency).
NOTE: Not supported with model 'eleven_v3'. If using eleven_v3, leave this parameter unset.

pronunciation_dictionary_locators.description: List of up to 3 pronunciation dictionary locators, applied sequentially. Each dictionary must contain `pronunciation_dictionary_id` and `version_id`.

HEYGEN_GENERATE_TEXT_TO_SPEECH.description: Tool to generate a speech audio file from any text input using a specified voice, powered by HeyGen's Starfish model. Use when you need to convert text to speech audio with high-quality voice synthesis.

examples: Hello, this is a test of the HeyGen text to speech API.
text.description: The text content to convert to speech

voice_id.description: The ID of the voice to use for speech generation. Can be obtained from the List All Voices (V2) endpoint
